commit.message:
Add libgles-dev rosdep key (#54044)

* Add opengl-es rosdep key

Debian/Ubuntu's libgles-dev ships GLES/GLES2/GLES3 headers and the
glesv2 pkgconfig file. Packages such as MRPT's mrpt_opengl probe for
these at their own build time and expose the result in an installed
header, so downstream consumers building against that header need the
same GLES dev headers available, which the existing opengl key (mesa
GL/GLU only) does not provide.

Only debian and ubuntu are covered here; I could not confirm the exact
package names on other platforms with confidence.

* Rename opengl-es key to libgles-dev, matching the Ubuntu package name

* libgles-dev: add rules for alpine, arch, fedora, gentoo, nixos, opensuse and rhel

commit.message:
Remove acado_vendor from Rolling. (#54194)

The package fails to build on modern CMake.  To fix that,
we'd have to update both the acado_vendor package and the
thing it vendored.  acado_vendor has had no activity since
2021, and the thing it vendors (acado) has had no activity
since 2019.  Further, nothing else in Rolling currently
depends on this package.  So remove it until someone wants
to do the work to get it back.

Signed-off-by: Chris Lalancette <clalancette@gmail.com>
